d: Banda Singh Bahadur was once a peaceful ascetic known as Madho Das Bairagi. But one meeting with Guru Gobind Singh changed his life forever. This episode of Tarikh tells the extraordinary story of how a saint became a warrior and challenged the mighty Mughal Empire. From leading farmers and common people into battle to establishing the first Sikh capital at Lohgarh, Banda Bahadur emerged as one of the fiercest enemies of Mughal rule. The video also explores his final days, the brutal torture he endured, the execution of his young son before his eyes, and one of the most horrifying deaths…
